category: an element with no text (pick and Inspector)
symptom: In the Products list the small coloured dots are grey for Desk lamp, Ladder and Label maker, while other products have coloured dots.
cause: markColor looks the offer up in OFFER_COLORS by the sheet's spelling; the sheet writes Sale, Clearance and New with a capital letter, OFFERS keeps them as written and the lookup misses, so those rows get the grey NO_OFFER colour.
